items.span_text: Life Technologies shall keep Biocept fully informed as to all discoveries and technical developments (including, without limitations, any inventions) made by Life Technologies during the Term related to the Assay or Tests
items.annotator_notes: Both parties named individually and in-span, no unresolvable date, trigger or bd duration, so 3.9 has no trigger and underspecified is FALSE. ACTION is the one genuinely open field and 3.4's accept-set is doing the work. The literal verb phrase is 'keep ... fully informed', a continuing disclosure duty; it is defensibly mappable rather than a genuine 8.8 gap (the same shape as 8.8's own 'continue to maintain -> MAINTAIN'), so no action_not_in_taxonomy tag. NOTIFY is my single best value, with REPORT, DISCLOSE, PROVIDE and INFORM all defensible from the sentence alone -- the eval pilot's recorded PROVIDE/REPORT case is this exact ambiguity, and 3.4 exists so a correct extraction picking a sibling is not scored wrong. I could not check ACTIONS membership for any of them because compiler/ast.py is outside this pass's permitted directory; the set is authored from the sentence alone per 3.4's justification test, not fitted to any prediction. NO compound_action tag: 'keep ... informed' is one verb phrase, not two coordinated verbs. TEMPORAL null, and this is the segment's finest call. 'during the Term' is present, and 8's gap table has a 'during the Term' row (UNMAPPABLE_TEMPORAL, since _DURING_RE needs two ISO dates), but here the phrase sits inside the participial 'made by Life Technologies during the Term related to the Assay or Tests', which modifies WHICH discoveries are covered rather than when the duty is performed -- object scope by 3.8.2's removal test, exactly as 'in connection with any action, suit or other proceeding' is in that section's own table. The competing reading takes it as the obligation's own DURING temporal; that would change clause 6 and add a known-gap tag. I record it rather than adopt it because the phrase's syntactic attachment is to 'made', not to 'shall keep'. conditions is empty for the same reason: 'related to the Assay or Tests' and the parenthetical '(including, without limitations, any inventions)' are both object scope, not circumstances under which the duty applies.

segment_notes: 1 item. Single-sentence segment, one obligation-bearing clause, inside 2's 1-3 band. '(f) Technical Developments.' is an enumeration marker plus heading; per 2.6 an incidental list marker does not make the segment an orphan fragment when the sentence carries its own subject and modal, and this sentence does. The heading is outside the span. Self-containment (2, checked per sentence under 2.6): 'the Term', 'the Assay' and 'Tests' are defined terms used but not resolved here -- however 2's row is a SCORED-FIELD dependence test as of v0.28, and every one of 5's eight clauses is determinable from the sentence itself, so mere presence does not exclude. No redaction, no OCR corruption, no mid-sentence corpus artifact, no carve-out marker, no vague temporal qualifier.
